rows.rationale: The visible tests are pure-function tests. They build their inputs inline as literals (add(2, 3), parse_age("-1")) and use no fixtures or factories, and the policy says pure tests need none. The assertions are specific: an exact equality, and pytest.raises(ValueError) for the negative-age path. The one excluded file was not assessed.

The visible tests declare no fixtures and hold no module-level state. The code under test, add and parse_age, is stateless: it has no globals, no imports, and no mutation outside local variables. No mutable state is shared between tests. The one excluded file was not assessed.

The test module imports only pytest and demo. The demo package has no imports and contains only integer arithmetic and int parsing. pyproject.toml declares no dependencies. The visible test import graph therefore contains no database, server, or schema setup.
The tests and the code under test are pure computations that import nothing beyond pytest and demo. No database identities, records, or cleanup paths exist in the visible import graph.
No cache client is imported anywhere in the tests or in demo. pyproject.toml declares no Redis, Valkey, or other cache dependency. The functions under test are pure.
The tests and the code under test open no files, create no temp paths, and bind no sockets. The only operations are integer addition and int() parsing of in-memory strings.
No network client, library, or target appears in the tests or in demo. The demo package has no imports at all, and pyproject.toml declares no dependencies.
The tests and the code under test spawn no subprocesses, threads, or background workers. The runner config sets lifecycle to cooperative-process-group with workers = 1.
No clock reads, sleeps, timeouts, or synchronization primitives appear in the tests or in the code under test. Both functions are deterministic pure computations.

.ptest.toml explicitly disables selection (enabled = false), with closed_inputs = false and empty input_roots and full_triggers. No source-to-test selection is configured, so there are no selection inputs or fallbacks to judge.
The packet contains no ptest result or history timing data, so per-test durations cannot be interpreted.

limitations.message: One file in scope was excluded from the packet and was not assessed. The not-applicable and satisfied judgments rest on the visible test module, source module, and configuration.
No authoritative Python lockfile was admitted, so lock provenance is unknown.
Environments other than the reported project-local metadata were not inspected.
No per-test timing data was supplied in the packet.
This assessment is static and based only on packet excerpts. No tests were executed.
